claims: Charles Robert Redford Jr. was born on August 18, 1936.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was born in Santa Monica, California.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. died on September 16, 2025.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. died at age 89.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. died at his home in Utah.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was an American actor, director, producer, and founder of the Sundance Film Institute.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. had leading roles in Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. had leading roles in The Sting.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. won an Oscar for directing Ordinary People (1980).
Charles Robert Redford Jr. received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2016.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was married to Sibylle Szaggars (2009–2025).
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was married to Lola Van Wagenen (1958–1985).
Charles Robert Redford Jr. had four children with Lola Van Wagenen: Scott, Shauna, David, and Amy.
Scott died in infancy.
David died in 2020.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was raised in Santa Monica.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. was a baseball player in high school.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. briefly attended the University of Colorado on a baseball scholarship.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. founded the Sundance Film Institute and Festival in 1981.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. directed Quiz Show.
Charles Robert Redford Jr. directed A River Runs Through It.
